main.description: Publish an existing version's artifact under a new version, such as `1.2.0-rc.1` as `1.2.0`, without uploading it again. The new software.release.version points at the existing manifest. Optionally moves a channel to it and adds a changelog.

name.description: The project's name, which is the record key of its software.release.project: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and interior hyphens.

fromVersion.description: The published version whose manifest the new version reuses.

track.description: A channel to move to the new version. No channel moves when absent.

changelog.description: Release notes as CommonMark. The registry writes them to the caller's repo as a site.standard.document and links it from the version.

resumed.description: True when the new version already existed on the same manifest, so this call only finished what an earlier one started.

channel.description: The software.release.channel, when track was given.

changelog.description: The changelog's site.standard.document, when a changelog was given.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to write to.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured. An operator problem, not a caller's.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The input breaks a rule the registry applies, so it would refuse the records. The message names the field.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: A record could not be written to the caller's repo. Records written before the failure stay, and the same call can be made again.

errors.name: ProjectMissing
errors.description: The caller has no project of that name, or the registry has not indexed its at.happyproto.registry.project record. Call putProject first.

errors.name: VersionNotFound
errors.description: fromVersion is not an indexed version of the caller's project.

errors.name: VersionExists
errors.description: The new version is already published. A version never changes once published.

errors.name: NotInstallable
errors.description: track was given, but the project is unavailable or retired, so a channel cannot point at the new version.
